<style id="hojaTeamR14FruitBoltStyles">
/* Five separate narrow firebolts. Effects are DOM-only and never adjust the game camera. */
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] .htFruitFirebolt{position:absolute;width:21px;height:21px;border-radius:54% 46% 63% 37%;pointer-events:none;z-index:13;background:radial-gradient(circle at 36% 33%,#ffffff 0 10%,#fffac6 18%,#ffe15c 43%,#ff941e 69%,#ee471a 92%);box-shadow:0 0 9px 2px #ffe46bbb,0 0 15px 3px #ff8b3099;will-change:transform,opacity;filter:saturate(1.18)}
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] .htFruitFirebolt::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:3px 9px 3px -14px;border-radius:80% 16% 60% 24%;background:linear-gradient(100deg,transparent,#ff97268c 38%,#fff0a5cc);transform:rotate(-22deg);opacity:.94}
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] .htFruitFirebolt::after{content:"";position:absolute;width:9px;height:8px;left:6px;top:5px;border-radius:50%;background:#fffbdc;box-shadow:0 0 4px #fff}

@keyframes htFruitCountImpact{0%{filter:brightness(1);scale:1}30%{filter:brightness(1.4);scale:1.15}100%{filter:brightness(1);scale:1}}

<script id="hojaTeamV067Runtime">
"use strict";
/* HOJA V0.6.7 R17 TEAM BALANCE isolated TEST module. 
   R16 scoreplate design only, preserving R15 assets/ranks and R14 fruit flight.
   
   Project A team-play rule port; no Project B/Ranking/Sheets writes.
   Reuses HOJA's actual #hqCard question UI, #hqOverlay, balloon/pipe/fruit/enemy sprite assets.
*/
/* Trial-only: approved renderer authority; not a new layout engine. */
window.HOJA_UNIFIED_TRIAL_CORE=(()=>{
/**
 * Bind a team question to the teacher-approved renderer; no CSS/scoring/fallback.
 */
const TYPES = Object.freeze({MC3:'MCQ', OX:'OX', SUBJECTIVE:'SHORT'});
const object = v => v !== null && typeof v === 'object' && !Array.isArray(v);
const same = (a,b) => String(a ?? '').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim() === String(b ?? '').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();

function bindTeamApprovedQuestion(q) {
  if (!object(q) || !TYPES[q.type]) throw Error('TEAM_RENDER_UNSUPPORTED_TYPE');
  const source=q.approvedSource, row=source?.row, bank=source?.bank;
  const canonical=row?.rendererQuestion ?? row?.approvedQuestion;
  if (!object(canonical) || !canonical.id || canonical.type !== TYPES[q.type])
    throw Error('TEAM_RENDER_APPROVED_QUESTION_REQUIRED');
  if (source.questionId && ![canonical.id,canonical.questionId].includes(source.questionId))
    throw Error('TEAM_RENDER_QUESTION_ID_MISMATCH');
  const images=bank?.images ?? bank?.rendererImages;
  const tags=bank?.tags ?? bank?.rendererTags;
  const unitMeta=bank?.unitMeta;
  if (!object(images) || !object(tags) || !object(unitMeta))
    throw Error('TEAM_RENDER_APPROVED_ASSETS_REQUIRED');
  if (canonical.image && !Object.hasOwn(images,canonical.image)) throw Error('TEAM_RENDER_MISSING_IMAGE');
  for (const c of canonical.choices ?? []) {
    if (c.image && !Object.hasOwn(images,c.image)) throw Error('TEAM_RENDER_MISSING_CHOICE_IMAGE');
  }
  if (!canonical.renderTags && !tags[canonical.id]) throw Error('TEAM_RENDER_APPROVED_TAGS_REQUIRED');
  if (q.type === 'MC3') {
    if (!Array.isArray(canonical.choices) || ![3,4].includes(canonical.choices.length) ||
        !Array.isArray(q.sourceChoiceIndices) || q.sourceChoiceIndices.length !== 3)
      throw Error('TEAM_RENDER_CHOICE_MAPPING_REQUIRED');
    const selected=q.sourceChoiceIndices.map(i=>canonical.choices[i]);
    if (selected.some(c=>!c)) throw Error('TEAM_RENDER_CHOICE_INDEX_INVALID');
    if (!selected.every((c,i)=>same(c.text,q.choices[i]) ||
        (c.image && same(c.imageAlt,q.choices[i])))) throw Error('TEAM_RENDER_CHOICE_TEXT_MISMATCH');
    const ids=new Set(selected.map(c=>c.id));
    if (ids.size !== 3 || !ids.has(canonical.answer?.choiceId))
      throw Error('TEAM_RENDER_CHOICE_ANSWER_MISMATCH');
    const omitted=canonical.choices.filter(c=>!ids.has(c.id));
    if (omitted.length>1 || omitted.some(c=>c.id===canonical.answer.choiceId))
      throw Error('TEAM_RENDER_CHOICE_MAPPING_INVALID');
    return Object.freeze({questionId:canonical.id,rendererQuestion:canonical,
      omitChoiceId:omitted[0]?.id ?? null,
      choiceIdToIndex:Object.freeze(Object.fromEntries(selected.map((c,i)=>[c.id,i]))),
      images,tags,unitMeta,teamQuestionNumber:q.num});
  }
  if (q.type === 'OX') {
    if (typeof canonical.answer?.value !== 'boolean' ||
        (canonical.answer.value ? 0 : 1) !== q.answer) throw Error('TEAM_RENDER_OX_ANSWER_MISMATCH');
    return Object.freeze({questionId:canonical.id,rendererQuestion:canonical,
      omitChoiceId:null,choiceIdToIndex:Object.freeze({'true':0,'false':1}),images,tags,unitMeta,teamQuestionNumber:q.num});
  }
  if (!same(canonical.answer?.text,q.answerText)) throw Error('TEAM_RENDER_SHORT_ANSWER_MISMATCH');
  return Object.freeze({questionId:canonical.id,rendererQuestion:canonical,
    omitChoiceId:null,choiceIdToIndex:Object.freeze({}),images,tags,unitMeta,teamQuestionNumber:q.num});
}
function teamRendererAnswerIndex(binding, choiceId) {
  if (!object(binding?.choiceIdToIndex) || typeof choiceId!=='string' ||
      !Object.hasOwn(binding.choiceIdToIndex,choiceId)) throw Error('TEAM_RENDER_UNKNOWN_CHOICE_ID');
  return binding.choiceIdToIndex[choiceId];
}
function teamApprovedPayload(bindings) {
  if (!Array.isArray(bindings) || !bindings.length) throw Error('TEAM_RENDER_BINDINGS_REQUIRED');
  const ids=new Set(),questions=[],images={},tags={},unitMeta={};
  for (const b of bindings) {
    if (!b?.questionId || ids.has(b.questionId)) throw Error('TEAM_RENDER_DUPLICATE_QUESTION');
    ids.add(b.questionId);questions.push(b.rendererQuestion);
    Object.assign(images,b.images);Object.assign(tags,b.tags);Object.assign(unitMeta,b.unitMeta);
  }
  return {questions,images,tags,unitMeta,mode:'team'};
}


/** Command/event host for the original teacher-approved A/C/D renderer. No scoring here. */
function createApprovedFrameHost({frame,onAnswer=()=>{},timeoutMs=6000}={}) {
 if(!frame||frame.tagName!=='IFRAME'||typeof onAnswer!=='function') throw Error('HOJA_FRAME_OPTIONS_REQUIRED');
 const hostId=window.__hojaFrameHostSequence=(window.__hojaFrameHostSequence||0)+1;
 const pending=new Map();let seq=0,closed=false,activeId=null,activePresentation=null,accepted=false,generation=0;
 const reset=()=>{generation++;activeId=null;activePresentation=null;accepted=false};
 function onMessage(ev){
   if(closed||ev.source!==frame.contentWindow)return;
   const d=ev.data;if(!d||typeof d!=='object')return;
   if(d.type==='HOJA_UNIFIED_RESULT'){
     const job=pending.get(d.requestId);if(!job)return;
     clearTimeout(job.timer);pending.delete(d.requestId);
     if(d.ok)job.resolve(d);else job.reject(Error('HOJA_RENDERER_COMMAND_FAILED: '+d.error));
   } else if(d.type==='HOJA_UNIFIED_ANSWER'){
     if(typeof d.questionId!=='string'||d.questionId!==activeId||d.presentationId!==activePresentation||!activePresentation||accepted||!d.choiceId)return;
     accepted=true;
     onAnswer(Object.freeze({questionId:d.questionId,choiceId:String(d.choiceId),choiceText:String(d.choiceText||'')}));
   }
 }
 window.addEventListener('message',onMessage);
 function request(action,payload){
   if(closed)return Promise.reject(Error('HOJA_FRAME_CLOSED'));
   if(!frame.contentWindow)return Promise.reject(Error('HOJA_FRAME_NOT_READY'));
   const requestId='hq-'+hostId+'-'+(++seq);
   return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{
     const timer=setTimeout(()=>{pending.delete(requestId);reject(Error('HOJA_RENDERER_TIMEOUT: '+action))},timeoutMs);
     pending.set(requestId,{timer,resolve,reject});
     frame.contentWindow.postMessage({type:'HOJA_UNIFIED_COMMAND',action,payload,requestId},'*');
   });
 }
 return Object.freeze({
   async initialize(){await request('embed');await request('capture',true);return true},
   async load(payload){reset();return request('load',payload)},
   async show({questionId,mode='team',omitChoiceId=null}={}){
     if(typeof questionId!=='string'||!questionId)throw Error('HOJA_QUESTION_ID_REQUIRED');
     reset();const currentGeneration=generation;const response=await request('show',{questionId,mode,omitChoiceId});if(!closed&&generation===currentGeneration){activeId=questionId;activePresentation=response.requestId;}return response;
   },
   async inspect(){return request('inspect')},
   suspend(){reset()},
   close(){
     if(closed)return;closed=true;reset();window.removeEventListener('message',onMessage);
     for(const job of pending.values()){clearTimeout(job.timer);job.reject(Error('HOJA_FRAME_CLOSED'))}
     pending.clear();
   }
 });
}


/** Team/single wrong-answer review controller. Never changes original score, rank, or winner. */
function teamWrongAnswerRows({questions,done,teams}){
 if(!Array.isArray(questions)||!(done instanceof Map)||!Array.isArray(teams))throw new TypeError('TEAM_REVIEW_SOURCE_INVALID');
 const byNumber=new Map(questions.map(q=>[q.num,q])),items=[];
 for(const [number,record] of done){
  if(record?.correct!==false)continue;
  const q=byNumber.get(number);
  if(!q||!Number.isInteger(record.team)||!teams[record.team])throw Error('TEAM_REVIEW_RECORD_MISMATCH');
  if(!q.rendererQuestion||!q.rendererQuestion.id||!['MCQ','OX','SHORT'].includes(q.rendererQuestion.type))throw Error('TEAM_REVIEW_APPROVED_RENDER_DATA_REQUIRED');
  items.push(Object.freeze({id:'team:'+number,questionId:q.rendererQuestion.id,number,teamIndex:record.team,teamName:teams[record.team].name,type:q.rendererQuestion.type,rendererQuestion:q.rendererQuestion,originalCorrect:false}));
 }
 return Object.freeze(items.sort((a,b)=>a.number-b.number));
}
function singleWrongAnswerRows(records){
 if(!Array.isArray(records))throw new TypeError('SINGLE_REVIEW_SOURCE_INVALID');
 return Object.freeze(records.filter(r=>r.correct===false).map((r,i)=>{
  if(!r.rendererQuestion||!r.rendererQuestion.id)throw Error('SINGLE_REVIEW_APPROVED_RENDER_DATA_REQUIRED');
  return Object.freeze({id:String(r.id??'single:'+(i+1)),questionId:r.rendererQuestion.id,type:r.rendererQuestion.type,rendererQuestion:r.rendererQuestion,originalCorrect:false});
 }));
}
function createReviewSession(rows,onComplete=()=>{}){
 if(!Array.isArray(rows)||typeof onComplete!=='function')throw new TypeError('REVIEW_SESSION_INVALID');
 const ids=new Set();
 for(const r of rows){if(!r||typeof r.id!=='string'||ids.has(r.id)||!['MCQ','OX','SHORT'].includes(r.type)||!r.rendererQuestion)throw Error('REVIEW_SESSION_ROW_INVALID');ids.add(r.id);}
 const originals=Object.freeze(rows.slice());
 let pending=originals.slice(),thisRound=[],failed=[],index=0,phase='ready',round=0,notified=false;
 const log=[];
 const state=()=>Object.freeze({phase,round,remaining:pending.length,current:(phase==='asking'||phase==='answered')?thisRound[index]:null,originalCount:originals.length,complete:phase==='complete'});
 const finishZero=()=>{
  if(pending.length)throw Error('REVIEW_PENDING_NOT_EMPTY');
  phase='complete';if(!notified){notified=true;onComplete({rounds:round,reviewed:originals.length,log:log.slice()});}return state();
 };
 return Object.freeze({
  get state(){return state();},get log(){return Object.freeze(log.slice());},
  beginRound(){
   if(phase==='complete')return state();
   if(phase!=='ready'&&phase!=='roundEnd')throw Error('REVIEW_ROUND_STATE');
   if(!pending.length)return finishZero();
   thisRound=pending.slice();failed=[];index=0;round++;phase='asking';return state();
  },
  mark(correct){
   if(phase!=='asking'||typeof correct!=='boolean')throw Error('REVIEW_ANSWER_STATE');
   const row=thisRound[index];if(!correct)failed.push(row);
   log.push(Object.freeze({id:row.id,questionId:row.questionId,round,correct}));
   phase='answered';return state();
  },
  next(){
   if(phase!=='answered')throw Error('REVIEW_NEXT_STATE');
   if(++index<thisRound.length){phase='asking';return state();}
   pending=failed.slice();phase='roundEnd';return state();
  },
  finish(){
   if(phase==='complete')return state();
   if(phase!=='ready'&&phase!=='roundEnd')throw Error('REVIEW_FINISH_STATE');
   return finishZero();
  }
 });
}
/** Client precheck only. Server-side verified review completion remains to be built. */
function canShowArcadeRanking({mode,unitCount,finish,reviewComplete}){
 return mode==='singleArcade'&&unitCount===1&&finish==='FINISH'&&reviewComplete===true;
}

return Object.freeze({bindTeamApprovedQuestion,teamRendererAnswerIndex,teamApprovedPayload,createApprovedFrameHost,teamWrongAnswerRows,createReviewSession});
})();


/* Only the trial copy invokes this. The browser host does not calculate score. */
window.HOJA_TRIAL_APPROVED_HTML=/* HOJA_TRIAL_APPROVED_HTML_INLINE */null;
/* Trial-only intro sound ownership: stop scene events, retain shared BGM and gameplay SFX. */
window.HOJA_TRIAL_SCENE_AUDIO=(()=>{
 let suspendGeneration=0, pausePending=false, pauseListener=null;
 function suspendAttract(){
   const scene=window.HOJA_ATTRACT_SCENE,loop=window.HOJA_ATTRACT_GAME?.loop;
   if(!scene?.scene?.pause||!loop?.sleep||!scene.events?.once)return false;
   try{
     if(pausePending)return true;
     const generation=++suspendGeneration;
     if(scene.scene.isPaused?.()){loop.sleep();return true;}
     pausePending=true;
     pauseListener=()=>{
       pauseListener=null;
       if(generation!==suspendGeneration)return;
       pausePending=false;
       if(scene.scene.isPaused?.())loop.sleep();
     };
     scene.events.once('pause',pauseListener);
     scene.scene.pause();
     return true;
   }catch(err){if(pauseListener)scene.events.off('pause',pauseListener);pauseListener=null;pausePending=false;++suspendGeneration;console.warn('HOJA intro pause failed',err);return false;}
 }
 function resumeAttract(){
   const scene=window.HOJA_ATTRACT_SCENE,loop=window.HOJA_ATTRACT_GAME?.loop;
   if(!scene?.scene?.resume)return false;
   try{
     const wasPending=pausePending;pausePending=false;++suspendGeneration;
     if(pauseListener)scene.events.off('pause',pauseListener);pauseListener=null;
     if(!scene.pausedByUser&&(wasPending||scene.scene.isPaused?.()))scene.scene.resume();
     loop?.wake?.();
     return !scene.pausedByUser;
   }catch(err){console.warn('HOJA intro resume failed',err);return false;}
 }
 const flow=window.HOJA_FLOW;
 if(flow&&typeof flow.enterIntro==='function'){
   const enter=flow.enterIntro;
   flow.enterIntro=function(...args){const output=enter.apply(this,args);resumeAttract();return output;};
 }
 return Object.freeze({suspendAttract,resumeAttract});
})();

window.HOJA_ARCADE_APPROVED_TRIAL=/* HOJA_ARCADE_APPROVED_RUNTIME_INLINE */null;
window.HOJA_TEAM_APPROVED_TRIAL=(()=>{
 const core=window.HOJA_UNIFIED_TRIAL_CORE;
 // HOJA 1.5: show the frame only after the choices of THIS question are painted (no text-only flash). // HOJA 1.5 (40-6CI): Chrome pauses requestAnimationFrame in a hidden/minimized window, so the renderer cannot answer
 // (HOJA_RENDERER_TIMEOUT). That is not a failure: wait until the page is visible again and retry (no alert).
 const hojaIsTimeout_=e=>/HOJA_RENDERER_TIMEOUT/.test(String(e&&e.message||e));
 const hojaWhenVisible_=()=>document.visibilityState==='visible'?Promise.resolve():new Promise(r=>{const f=()=>{if(document.visibilityState==='visible'){document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange',f);r();}};document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',f);});
 async function hojaRetryRender_(fn){for(let i=0;;i++){try{return await fn();}catch(e){if(!hojaIsTimeout_(e)||i>=3)throw e;await hojaWhenVisible_();await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400));}}}

 function hojaWhenDrawn_(f,qid){return new Promise(res=>{const t0=performance.now();const tick=()=>{let ok=false;try{const d=f.contentDocument,w=f.contentWindow;const cur=w.current&&w.current();const bs=[...d.querySelectorAll('#hqChoices button.hqChoice')];ok=!d.body.classList.contains('hojaAwaitShow')&&bs.length>0&&(!qid||(cur&&cur.id===qid))&&bs.every(b=>!b.dataset.hojaQid||b.dataset.hojaQid===(cur&&cur.id));}catch(_e){ok=true}if(ok||performance.now()-t0>1500){requestAnimationFrame(()=>res());return;}requestAnimationFrame(tick)};tick();});}
 let frame=null,host=null,loading=null,loaded=null,answerHandler=null,serial=0;
 let header=null,nextButton=null,judgment=null,retryButton=null;
 function overlay(){return document.getElementById('hqOverlay')}
 function clearJudgment(){if(judgment){judgment.remove();judgment=null;}}
 function clearRetry(){if(retryButton){retryButton.remove();retryButton=null;}}
 function showJudgment(correct){
   if(overlay()?.dataset.hojaUnified!=='yes')return;
   clearJudgment();
   judgment=document.createElement('div');judgment.id='hojaSoloJudgment';
   judgment.setAttribute('role','status');judgment.setAttribute('aria-live','assertive');
   judgment.style.cssText='position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:45;display:grid;place-items:center;pointer-events:none;background:rgba(5,12,21,.48)';
   const mark=document.createElement('div');
   mark.style.cssText='border-radius:20px;box-shadow:0 12px 55px #000a;padding:22px 45px;max-width:90%;font:900 clamp(28px,4.5vw,54px)/1.2 system-ui,sans-serif;text-align:center;color:#fff;border:4px solid rgba(255,255,255,.75);background:'+(correct?'#176c4b':'#a12b37');
   mark.textContent=correct?'✓ 정답! +10점':'✕ 오답 · 0점';
   judgment.append(mark);overlay().append(judgment);
 }
 function inputWindow(){return frame?.contentWindow||null}
 function error(reason){
   // HOJA 1.5: closing the question frame on purpose ('이전', mode change) is not an error -> no alert.
   if(/HOJA_FRAME_CLOSED/.test(String(reason?.message||reason)))return;
   const m='승인 공통 렌더러 연결 실패: '+String(reason?.message||reason);
   console.error('[HOJA unified team trial]',reason);
   window.alert(m+'\n점수와 팀 턴은 진행하지 않습니다.');
 }
 function prepareFrame(){
   if(loading)return loading;
   const source=window.HOJA_TRIAL_APPROVED_HTML;
   if(typeof source!=='string'||!source.includes('HOJA_APPROVED_RENDERER'))
     return Promise.reject(Error('APPROVED_HTML_TRIAL_SOURCE_REQUIRED'));
   const pane=overlay();frame=document.createElement('iframe');
   frame.id='hojaTeamApprovedTrialFrame';frame.title='교사 승인 HOJA 문제 화면';
   frame.style.cssText='position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;border:0;background:#071421;z-index:30';
   pane.appendChild(frame);
   header=document.createElement('div');header.id='hojaTeamReviewHeader';
   header.style.cssText='position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:0;min-height:41px;background:#12293e;color:#fff3cc;z-index:32;padding:8px 15px;font-weight:900;font-size:clamp(16px,1.6vw,24px);display:none';
   const label=document.createElement('span');label.id='hojaTeamReviewLabel';header.append(label);
   nextButton=document.createElement('button');nextButton.id='hojaTeamReviewNext';nextButton.type='button';
   nextButton.style.cssText='float:right;background:#23555a;color:white;border:2px solid #83c9be;border-radius:9px;padding:6px 18px;font:900 clamp(15px,1.4vw,22px) system-ui;cursor:pointer;display:none';
   header.append(nextButton);pane.append(header);
   loading=new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{
     frame.addEventListener('load',async()=>{
       try{
         // HOJA 1.5: the renderer's own 'HOJA · 혼자 놀기 / ROUND / TEAM / QUESTION' strip is not used in the game.
         try{const d=frame.contentDocument;if(d&&!d.getElementById('hoja15NoTopStrip')){const st=d.createElement('style');st.id='hoja15NoTopStrip';st.textContent='body.hoja-embedded #hqTop{display:none!important}body.hoja-embedded #hqType,body.hoja-embedded #hqHint,body.hoja-embedded #hqStemLabel{display:none!important}body.hoja-embedded #hqStage{height:100%!important}';(d.head||d.documentElement).append(st);const sc=d.createElement('script');sc.textContent='(function(){if(window.__hoja15Fit)return;window.__hoja15Fit=1;fitScreen=function(){var a=state.res.split("x").map(Number),host=document.getElementById("screenWrap"),scr=document.getElementById("screen");var s=Math.min((host.clientWidth-4)/a[0],(host.clientHeight-4)/a[1]);scr.style.transform="scale("+s+") translate(-50%,-50%)";requestAnimationFrame(fitContent);};function fit(){try{var W=innerWidth,H=innerHeight;if(!W||!H)return;var h=1000,w=Math.max(1280,Math.min(2560,Math.round(h*W/H))),r=w+"x"+h;if(state.res!==r){state.res=r;updateStage();}fitScreen();}catch(e){}}addEventListener("resize",fit);fit();})();';(d.head||d.documentElement).append(sc);frame.contentWindow.dispatchEvent(new Event('resize'));}}catch(_e){}
         host=core.createApprovedFrameHost({frame,onAnswer:(d)=>answerHandler?.(d),timeoutMs:10000});
         await hojaRetryRender_(()=>host.initialize());resolve(host);
       }catch(e){reject(e);}
     },{once:true});
     frame.addEventListener('error',()=>reject(Error('APPROVED_IFRAME_LOAD_FAILED')),{once:true});
     frame.srcdoc=source;
   });
   return loading;
 }
 function begin(questions){
   const bindings=questions.map(q=>q.approvedBinding);
   const payload=core.teamApprovedPayload(bindings);
   serial++;answerHandler=null;
   loaded=prepareFrame().then(async h=>{await hojaRetryRender_(()=>h.load(payload));return h;});
   loaded.catch(error);return loaded;
 }
 function reveal(){
   const pane=overlay();pane.hidden=false;pane.dataset.hojaUnified='yes';
   const card=document.getElementById('hqCard');if(card)card.style.display='none';
   // HOJA 1.5: keep the frame invisible until the NEW question is drawn (no flash of the previous question).
   if(frame){frame.style.visibility='hidden';frame.hidden=false;}
 }
 async function show(q,mode,onAnswer,caption=''){
   const token=++serial;answerHandler=null;clearJudgment();clearRetry();reveal();
   const withHeader=mode==='review'||!!caption;
   if(header){header.style.display=withHeader?'block':'none';document.getElementById('hojaTeamReviewLabel').textContent=caption;}
   // HOJA 1.5: the review header sits ABOVE the question (not over its top lines)
   if(frame){const hh=withHeader&&header?Math.ceil(header.getBoundingClientRect().height):0;frame.style.top=hh+'px';frame.style.height=hh?'calc(100% - '+hh+'px)':'100%';}
   if(nextButton)nextButton.style.display='none';
   let h;
   try {
     h=await loaded;
     if(token!==serial)return;
     if(!q?.approvedBinding)throw Error('APPROVED_BINDING_REQUIRED');
     await hojaRetryRender_(()=>h.show({questionId:q.approvedBinding.questionId,mode,omitChoiceId:q.approvedBinding.omitChoiceId}));
     if(token!==serial)return;
     if(frame)await hojaWhenDrawn_(frame,q.approvedBinding.questionId);
     if(token!==serial)return;
     if(frame)frame.style.visibility='visible';
     answerHandler=onAnswer;
   }catch(e){
     if(token!==serial)return;
     error(e);
     if(token!==serial||!h||/HOJA_FRAME_CLOSED/.test(String(e?.message||e)))return;
     retryButton=document.createElement('button');retryButton.id='hojaRendererRetry';retryButton.type='button';
     retryButton.textContent='문제 다시 불러오기';
     retryButton.style.cssText='position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);z-index:50;padding:16px 28px;border:3px solid #ffdb67;border-radius:14px;background:#23555a;color:white;font:900 clamp(20px,2.4vw,32px) system-ui,sans-serif;cursor:pointer';
     retryButton.onclick=()=>{if(token===serial)show(q,mode,onAnswer,caption);};
     overlay().append(retryButton);retryButton.focus();
   }
 }
 function reviewFeedback(label,onNext,correct,wrongText,nextText){
   if(!header||!nextButton)return;
   document.getElementById('hojaTeamReviewLabel').textContent=label;
   let done=false;const go=()=>{if(done)return;done=true;nextButton.style.display='none';window.removeEventListener('keydown',key,true);inputWindow()?.removeEventListener('keydown',key,true);clearJudgment();onNext();};
   const key=ev=>{if(ev.code==='Enter'||ev.code==='NumpadEnter'||ev.code==='Space'){ev.preventDefault();ev.stopImmediatePropagation();go();}};
   nextButton.textContent=nextText||'다음 문제 ▶';
   nextButton.style.display='inline-block';
   nextButton.onclick=go;
   // HOJA 1.5 (teacher): a clear green/red verdict in the review too, with a big next button.
   if(typeof correct==='boolean'&&overlay()?.dataset.hojaUnified==='yes'){
     clearJudgment();
     judgment=document.createElement('div');judgment.id='hojaSoloJudgment';judgment.dataset.review='yes';
     judgment.setAttribute('role','status');judgment.setAttribute('aria-live','assertive');
     judgment.style.cssText='position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:45;display:grid;place-items:center;align-content:center;gap:22px;pointer-events:none;background:rgba(5,12,21,.5)';
     const mark=document.createElement('div');
     mark.style.cssText='border-radius:20px;box-shadow:0 12px 55px #000a;padding:22px 45px;max-width:90%;font:900 clamp(30px,4.8vw,60px)/1.25 system-ui,sans-serif;text-align:center;color:#fff;border:4px solid rgba(255,255,255,.75);background:'+(correct?'#176c4b':'#a3263a');
     mark.textContent=correct?'✓ 정답!':(wrongText||'✕ 오답 · 다음 회차에 다시 풀어요');
     const big=document.createElement('button');big.type='button';big.id='hojaTeamReviewNextBig';big.textContent=nextText||'다음 문제 ▶';
     big.style.cssText='pointer-events:auto;justify-self:center;padding:14px 40px;border-radius:14px;border:3px solid #ffdb67;background:#23555a;color:#fff;font:900 clamp(20px,2.4vw,32px) system-ui,sans-serif;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 6px 20px #0008';
     big.onclick=go;judgment.append(mark,big);overlay().append(judgment);
     setTimeout(()=>{try{big.focus();}catch(_e){}},30);
   }
   window.addEventListener('keydown',key,true);inputWindow()?.addEventListener('keydown',key,true);
 }
 function hide(){
   serial++;answerHandler=null;clearJudgment();clearRetry();
   // HOJA 1.5: a mouse answer leaves keyboard focus inside the (now hidden) frame; give it back to the game.
   if(frame&&document.activeElement===frame){try{frame.blur();window.focus();}catch(_e){}}
   if(host)host.suspend();
   if(frame)frame.hidden=true;
   if(header)header.style.display='none';
   const pane=overlay();delete pane.dataset.hojaUnified;
   const card=document.getElementById('hqCard');if(card)card.style.display='';
 }
 function reset(){
   hide();
   if(host)host.close();
   if(frame)frame.remove();
   if(header)header.remove();
   frame=null;host=null;loading=null;loaded=null;header=null;nextButton=null;
 }
 return Object.freeze({begin,show,reviewFeedback,hide,reset,error,feedback:showJudgment,inputWindow});
})();

window.HOJA_TEAM_TEST=(()=>{
 const $=id=>document.getElementById(id);
 const COLORS=['#e7655c','#49bc82','#ef8bae','#65c7ee','#529ae5','#a483ea','#52beb9'];
 const shuffle=(a)=>{a=a.slice();for(let i=a.length-1;i>0;i--){const j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));[a[i],a[j]]=[a[j],a[i]];}return a;};
 const assets={};
 const TEAM_CHARACTERS=['HOJA','NAHANSANG','SUMAKSAE','CHILJIDO_ELDER','MURYEONG_KING','BANGASAYUSANG','GWANGGAETO_KING'];
 const TEAM_NAMES=['호자','나한상','수막새','칠지도','무령왕','반가사유상','광개토대왕'];
  const PORTRAITS=JSON.parse(document.getElementById('hojaTeamR10PortraitAssets').textContent);
  let teamEmotion=Array(7).fill('01_NEUTRAL'), emotionTimers=new Map(), portraitLayoutQueued=false;
  const SFX_GAIN='correct',SFX_LOSS='wrong';
 const bgSrc=id=>($(id)?.getAttribute('src')||'');
 const SPRITES={FRUIT:{frames:1},JUMPY:{frames:2},HERMIE:{frames:2},ROACH:{frames:2},OWL:{frames:3},BLANKEY:{frames:4},NAHAN:{frames:7,klass:'htNahanGreet'}};
 const SEASON_BG_IDS={spring:['sgSky','sgCloud1','sgCloud2','sgHills','sgForeground'],summer:['thTroSky','thTroCloudsBG','thTroClouds','thTroWaters'],autumn:['thAutDistant','thAutRow2','thAutRow1','thAutPiles','thAutTrees','thAutLeafTop'],winter:['thWinMountain','thWinHills','thWinFore']};
 let state=null,modal=null,modeEpoch=0;
 let visibleScores=null,fxBusy=false,fxRunId=0;
 let rankCards=null,rankLastOrder='',rankFinalScores=null,roundTimer=0,finalRaf=0,finalBusy=false;
 const rankPulse=new Map();
 let finalResults=null,finalStage=0;
 const fxTimers=new Set();
 function stopFx(){fxRunId++;fxBusy=false;visibleScores=null;for(const t of fxTimers)clearTimeout(t);fxTimers.clear();$('htFxLayer')?.replaceChildren();}
 function fxLater(ms,run,token){const t=setTimeout(()=>{fxTimers.delete(t);if(token===fxRunId&&state)run();},ms);fxTimers.add(t);return t;}
 function scoreSnapshot(){return state.teams.map(t=>t.score);}

 const phaseIs=(...args)=>!!state&&args.includes(state.phase);
 function stopRoundAndFinal(){
   clearTimeout(roundTimer);roundTimer=0; if(finalRaf)cancelAnimationFrame(finalRaf);finalRaf=0;finalBusy=false;finalResults=null;finalStage=0;rankFinalScores=null;
   const banner=$('htRoundAnnouncement');if(banner)banner.hidden=true;
 }
 function ensureRoundHud(){
   if(!rankCards){
     const top=$('hojaGamePlay').querySelector('.hqTop');const row=document.createElement('div');row.id='htRankHud';row.setAttribute('aria-label','실시간 팀 점수 순위');
     top.insertBefore(row,$('hqModeLabel'));rankCards=new Map();
   }
   if(!$('htRoundAnnouncement')){
     const overlay=document.createElement('div');overlay.id='htRoundAnnouncement';overlay.hidden=true;overlay.setAttribute('aria-live','assertive');
     const caption=document.createElement('span');caption.id='htRoundAnnouncementSub';caption.textContent='HOJA TEAM BATTLE';
     const title=document.createElement('strong');title.id='htRoundAnnouncementTitle';overlay.append(caption,title);$('hqStage').append(overlay);
   }
 }
 function clearRankPulse(){
   for(const value of rankPulse.values())clearTimeout(value.timer);
   rankPulse.clear();
 }
 function rankBand(rank,count){
   const edge=Math.max(1,Math.floor((count+1)/3));
   return rank<edge?'top':rank>=count-edge?'bottom':'middle';
 }
 function rankEmotion(team,rank,count){
   const pulse=rankPulse.get(team);
   if(pulse)return pulse.emotion;
   const band=rankBand(rank,count);
   if(band==='top')return team%2===0?'09_SPARKLING':'05_SHY';
   if(band==='bottom')return team%2===0?'06_SAD':'04_TIRED';
   return team%2===0?'01_NEUTRAL':'07_SLEEPY';
 }
 function updateRankPortrait(team,rank,total,score){
   const card=rankCards.get(team), emotion=rankEmotion(team,rank,total);
   const source=PORTRAITS.characters[TEAM_CHARACTERS[team]]?.emotions?.[emotion];
   if(!card||!source)return;
   const image=card.querySelector('.htRankPortrait');
   // Rank displays are independent of the emotion state/timers of side portraits.
   if(image.dataset.emotion!==emotion){
     image.src=source.imageData;image.dataset.emotion=emotion;
     // Crop 384px transparent artwork to its visible silhouette, in a fixed 62px square.
     const bb=source.visibleBounds||[0,0,384,384],w=Math.max(1,bb[2]-bb[0]),h=Math.max(1,bb[3]-bb[1]);
     const scale=Math.min(60/w,60/h);
     image.style.width=(384*scale)+'px';image.style.height=(384*scale)+'px';
     image.style.left=((62-w*scale)/2-bb[0]*scale)+'px';
     image.style.top=((62-h*scale)/2-bb[1]*scale)+'px';
   }
   card.querySelector('.htRankPlace').textContent=String(rank+1)+'위';
   card.setAttribute('aria-label',`${rank+1}위 ${state.teams[team].name}, ${Math.round(score)}점`);
   card.title=`${rank+1}위 · ${state.teams[team].name} · ${Math.round(score)}점`;
   card.classList.toggle('rankUp',rankPulse.get(team)?.direction==='up');
   card.classList.toggle('rankDown',rankPulse.get(team)?.direction==='down');
 }
 function renderRanking(){
   if(!state||!rankCards)return;
   const row=$('htRankHud'), scores=rankFinalScores||visibleScores||state.teams.map(t=>t.score);
   const sorted=state.teams.map((_,i)=>i).sort((a,b)=>scores[b]-scores[a]||a-b);
   const previous=rankLastOrder?rankLastOrder.split(',').map(Number):[];
   for(let i=0;i<state.teams.length;i++){
     let card=rankCards.get(i);
     if(!card){
       card=document.createElement('div');card.className='htRankCard';card.dataset.team=String(i);
       const face=document.createElement('span');face.className='htRankFace';
       const image=document.createElement('img');image.className='htRankPortrait';image.alt='';image.decoding='async';image.draggable=false;
       face.append(image);
       const place=document.createElement('span');place.className='htRankPlace';
       card.append(face,place);rankCards.set(i,card);row.append(card);
     }
   }
   // Pulse only when actual rank changes, not when side-score portraits react.
   if(previous.length===sorted.length){
     for(let rank=0;rank<sorted.length;rank++){
       const id=sorted[rank],was=previous.indexOf(id);
       if(was<0||was===rank)continue;
       const prior=rankPulse.get(id);if(prior)clearTimeout(prior.timer);
       const epoch=state.epoch;
       const direction=rank<was?'up':'down';
       const emotion=direction==='up'?'09_SPARKLING':'06_SAD';
       const timer=setTimeout(()=>{rankPulse.delete(id);if(state&&state.epoch===epoch)renderRanking();},1500);
       rankPulse.set(id,{direction,emotion,timer});
     }
   }
   sorted.forEach((id,rank)=>updateRankPortrait(id,rank,sorted.length,scores[id]));
   const order=sorted.join(',');
   if(rankLastOrder!==order){
     const old=new Map();for(const [id,card] of rankCards)if(card.isConnected){const r=card.getBoundingClientRect();old.set(id,{left:r.left,top:r.top});}
     sorted.forEach(id=>row.append(rankCards.get(id)));
     for(const id of sorted){const card=rankCards.get(id),from=old.get(id);if(!from)continue;
       const after=card.getBoundingClientRect(),dx=from.left-after.left,dy=from.top-after.top;
       if(Math.abs(dx)>1||Math.abs(dy)>1)card.animate([{transform:`translate(${dx}px,${dy}px)`},{transform:'translate(0,0)'}],{duration:670,easing:'cubic-bezier(.22,.86,.27,1)'});
     }
     rankLastOrder=order;
   }
 }

 function announceRound(){
   if(!state||state.phase==='final')return;
   clearTimeout(roundTimer);roundTimer=0;ensureRoundHud();
   const total=Math.floor(state.limit/state.teams.length),round=Math.floor(state.turn/state.teams.length)+1;
   const final=round===total;state.phase='round';paint();
   const banner=$('htRoundAnnouncement');banner.classList.toggle('final',final);
   $('htRoundAnnouncementTitle').textContent=final?'FINAL ROUND':`${round}라운드`;banner.hidden=false;
   const epoch=state.epoch,turn=state.turn;
   roundTimer=setTimeout(()=>{roundTimer=0;if(!state||state.epoch!==epoch||state.turn!==turn||state.phase!=='round')return;banner.hidden=true;state.phase='board';paint();},final?2150:1650);
 }

  function portraitFor(index){
    const id=TEAM_CHARACTERS[index], key=teamEmotion[index]||'01_NEUTRAL';
    return PORTRAITS.characters[id]?.emotions?.[key]||null;
  }
  function portraitImage(index){
    const item=portraitFor(index);
    return item?.imageData||'';
  }
  function updatePortraitImage(index){
    const wrap=$('htTeamPortrait-'+index),image=$('htPortraitImage-'+index);
    if(!wrap||!image)return;
    const item=portraitFor(index);if(!item)return;
    if(image.dataset.emotion!==teamEmotion[index]){image.src=item.imageData;image.dataset.emotion=teamEmotion[index];}
    queuePortraitLayout();
  }
  function resetEmotionTimers(){for(const t of emotionTimers.values())clearTimeout(t);emotionTimers.clear();}
  function setTeamEmotion(index,key,restoreMs=0){
    if(!state||index<0||index>=state.teams.length)return;
    const current=emotionTimers.get(index);if(current){clearTimeout(current);emotionTimers.delete(index);}
    teamEmotion[index]=key;updatePortraitImage(index);
    if(restoreMs>0){const epoch=state.epoch;const timer=setTimeout(()=>{
       emotionTimers.delete(index);if(!state||state.epoch!==epoch)return;
       if(index===state.active&&state.phase==='question')return;
       setTeamEmotion(index,'01_NEUTRAL');
    },restoreMs);emotionTimers.set(index,timer);}
  }
  function reactToVerdict(ok){
    if(!state)return;
    const emotions=ok?['09_SPARKLING','02_SURPRISED','05_SHY']:['06_SAD','08_EMBARRASSED','04_TIRED'];
    setTeamEmotion(state.active,emotions[Math.floor(Math.random()*emotions.length)],4200);
  }
  // R16: one continuous path powers both the STEP silhouette and active ember.
  // The SVG stroke and the CSS offset-path use the exact same geometry at every resize.
  function updateScorePlateGeometry(index){
    const card=$('htTeamScore-'+index);if(!card)return null;
    const width=card.offsetWidth,height=card.offsetHeight;if(width<10||height<10)return null;
    const leftColumn=index%2===0, notchY=Math.round(height*.56);
    const scoreWidth=width*.60, nameWidth=width-scoreWidth;
    const split=leftColumn?nameWidth:scoreWidth;
    const r=Math.max(3,Math.min(13,height*.115,Math.min(scoreWidth,nameWidth)*.18));
    const W=width,H=height,S=split,N=notchY,R=r;
    const n=v=>Math.round(v*100)/100;
    let d;
    if(leftColumn){
      // Mirrored ㄴ: high score area on the RIGHT, lower narrow name LEFT.
      d=`M ${n(S+R)} ${n(2)} L ${n(W-R-2)} 2 Q ${n(W-2)} 2 ${n(W-2)} ${n(R+2)} `+
        `L ${n(W-2)} ${n(H-R-2)} Q ${n(W-2)} ${n(H-2)} ${n(W-R-2)} ${n(H-2)} `+
        `L ${n(R+2)} ${n(H-2)} Q 2 ${n(H-2)} 2 ${n(H-R-2)} `+
        `L 2 ${n(N+R)} Q 2 ${n(N+2)} ${n(R+2)} ${n(N+2)} `+
        `L ${n(S-R)} ${n(N+2)} Q ${n(S-2)} ${n(N+2)} ${n(S-2)} ${n(N-R)} `+
        `L ${n(S-2)} ${n(R+2)} Q ${n(S-2)} 2 ${n(S+R)} 2 Z`;
    }else{
      // ㄴ: high score area on the LEFT, lower narrow name RIGHT.
      d=`M ${n(R+2)} 2 L ${n(S-R)} 2 Q ${n(S+2)} 2 ${n(S+2)} ${n(R+2)} `+
        `L ${n(S+2)} ${n(N-R)} Q ${n(S+2)} ${n(N+2)} ${n(S+R)} ${n(N+2)} `+
        `L ${n(W-R-2)} ${n(N+2)} Q ${n(W-2)} ${n(N+2)} ${n(W-2)} ${n(N+R)} `+
        `L ${n(W-2)} ${n(H-R-2)} Q ${n(W-2)} ${n(H-2)} ${n(W-R-2)} ${n(H-2)} `+
        `L ${n(R+2)} ${n(H-2)} Q 2 ${n(H-2)} 2 ${n(H-R-2)} `+
        `L 2 ${n(R+2)} Q 2 2 ${n(R+2)} 2 Z`;
    }
    const svg=card.querySelector('.htScoreContour');
    if(svg){svg.setAttribute('viewBox',`0 0 ${width} ${height}`);svg.querySelector('path')?.setAttribute('d',d);}
    card.style.setProperty('--htScoreTrace',`path("${d}")`);
    const score=card.querySelector('.htTeamPts'),name=card.querySelector('.htTeamName');
    const scoreText=score?.textContent||'0', chars=Array.from(scoreText).length;
    const area=Math.max(23,scoreWidth-10);
    const scoreSize=Math.min(78,Math.max(19,area/Math.max(1,chars*.68)));
    card.style.setProperty('--htScoreFont',n(scoreSize)+'px');
    const nameText=name?.textContent||'';
    const count=Array.from(nameText).length;
    const nameSize=Math.min(23,Math.max(9,(nameWidth-7)/Math.max(1,count*.97)));
    card.style.setProperty('--htNameFont',n(nameSize)+'px');
    return {width,top:card.offsetTop,nameCenter:leftColumn?nameWidth/2:scoreWidth+nameWidth/2,notchY};
  }

  function layoutPortraits(){
    portraitLayoutQueued=false;
    if(!state)return;
    for(let index=0;index<state.teams.length;index++){
      const unit=$('htTeamUnit-'+index),card=$('htTeamScore-'+index),wrap=$('htTeamPortrait-'+index),image=$('htPortraitImage-'+index),pose=portraitFor(index);
      if(!unit||!card||!wrap||!image||!pose)continue;
      const flipped=index===0;
      const ax=flipped?384-Number(pose.imageAnchor.x):Number(pose.imageAnchor.x),ay=Number(pose.imageAnchor.y);
      image.style.transform=flipped?'scaleX(-1)':'';
      // R11: Preserve strict zero-offset anchors but use a SIDE-BIASED point on each card.
      // Odd-numbered teams are on the left column, even-numbered teams on the right.
      // Both anchors continue to coincide; only the target on the card is moved.
      // Use layout-box offsets, NOT getBoundingClientRect(): the full unit may
      // currently be scaled/rotated by a score reaction, which must never
      // distort the portrait anchor calculations between emotion frames.
      const plate=updateScorePlateGeometry(index);
      if(!plate)continue;
      const {width:cardWidth,top:cardTop,nameCenter,notchY}=plate;
      // In R16 the strict anchor touches the TOP of the narrow, stepped name zone.
      // It never jumps when different emotion images are swapped.
      const targetX=card.offsetLeft+nameCenter;
      const targetY=cardTop+notchY;
      const rawBounds=pose.visibleBounds||[0,0,384,384];
      const bounds=flipped?[384-Number(rawBounds[2]),Number(rawBounds[1]),384-Number(rawBounds[0]),Number(rawBounds[3])]:rawBounds;
      const stage=$('hqStage'),board=$('htTeamBoard');
      const unitStageX=board.offsetLeft+unit.parentElement.offsetLeft+unit.offsetLeft;
      const stageX=unitStageX+targetX, margin=6;
      // Preserve the EXACT image/name-panel anchor coincidence by shrinking the
      // portrait if needed, rather than translating the anchor independently.
      let maxScale=Math.min(.36,Math.max(.1,(targetY-6)/Math.max(1,ay-Number(bounds[1]))),cardWidth/395);
      if(ax>Number(bounds[0]))maxScale=Math.min(maxScale,Math.max(.05,(stageX-margin)/(ax-Number(bounds[0]))));
      if(Number(bounds[2])>ax)maxScale=Math.min(maxScale,Math.max(.05,(stage.clientWidth-margin-stageX)/(Number(bounds[2])-ax)));
      const scale=Math.max(.05,maxScale);
      const w=384*scale,h=384*scale;
      wrap.style.left=(targetX-ax*scale)+'px';wrap.style.top=(targetY-ay*scale)+'px';
      wrap.style.width=w+'px';wrap.style.height=h+'px';
      image.style.width=w+'px';image.style.height=h+'px';
      wrap.dataset.layoutReady='true';
    }
  }
  function queuePortraitLayout(){if(portraitLayoutQueued)return;portraitLayoutQueued=true;requestAnimationFrame(layoutPortraits);}
  function placeItemPanelInCenter(){
    const stage=$('hqStage'),center=$('htBoardCenter'),layer=$('htItemLayer');
    if(!stage||!center||!layer)return;
    const sr=stage.getBoundingClientRect(),cr=center.getBoundingClientRect();
    // Full modal remains available for final ranking only; items and pipes use center lane.
    const left=Math.max(0,cr.left-sr.left),width=Math.min(cr.width,sr.width-left);
    layer.style.setProperty('--ht-modal-left',left+'px');
    layer.style.setProperty('--ht-modal-width',Math.max(0,width)+'px');
  }
  function onScoreReaction(index,kind){
    if(!state||index>=state.teams.length)return;
    const arr=kind==='gain'?['09_SPARKLING','05_SHY','02_SURPRISED']:['06_SAD','08_EMBARRASSED','04_TIRED'];
    setTeamEmotion(index,arr[Math.floor(Math.random()*arr.length)],3200);
  }
 const act=(label,click,cls='')=>{const b=document.createElement('button');b.type='button';b.className='htAction '+cls;b.textContent=label;if(click)b.addEventListener('click',click);return b;};
 function init(){
   if(modal)return;
   const st=$('hqStage'),board=document.createElement('div');board.id='htTeamBoard';board.hidden=true;
   const left=document.createElement('div');left.className='htScores';left.id='htLeft';
   const center=document.createElement('div');center.className='htBoardCenter';
   const themeBg=document.createElement('div');themeBg.id='htThemeBg';
   const fx=document.createElement('div');fx.id='htFxLayer';
   const status=document.createElement('div');status.id='htStatus';status.className='htBoardStatus';
   const grid=document.createElement('div');grid.id='htBalloonGrid';grid.className='htBalloonGrid';

 function getScoreCard(index){return document.getElementById('htTeamScore-'+index);}

 // R17A: Score-transfer origins and destinations are the numeric score zones,
 // not the center of the L-shaped plate (which is biased toward portraits).
 function scoreFlightTarget(index){const card=getScoreCard(index);return card?.querySelector('.htScoreZone')||card||null;}

  }
 function easeOutCubic(t){return 1-Math.pow(1-t,3)}

 function animateScore(index,from,to,kind,label,delay=0){

     const tick=now=>{const t=Math.min(1,(now-start)/dur),v=Math.round(fromN+(toN-fromN)*easeOutCubic(t)); node.textContent=String(v); if(t<1) requestAnimationFrame(tick); else {node.textContent=String(toN);updateScorePlateGeometry(index);}};

 function particleLayer(){return $('htFxLayer');}

 function spawnParticleBurstAt(x,y,kind='gain',count=12){const layer=particleLayer(); if(!layer)return; for(let i=0;i<count;i++){const p=document.createElement('span'); p.className='htParticle '+kind; p.style.left=x+'px'; p.style.top=y+'px'; layer.append(p); const ang=(Math.PI*2*i)/count + Math.random()*0.45; const dist=18+Math.random()*28; requestAnimationFrame(()=>{p.style.transition='transform .6s ease, opacity .6s ease'; p.style.transform=`translate(${Math.cos(ang)*dist}px,${Math.sin(ang)*dist}px) scale(.2)`; p.style.opacity='0';}); setTimeout(()=>p.remove(),650);} }
 function spawnParticlesAlong(sx,sy,tx,ty,kind='gain',count=14,delay=0){const layer=particleLayer(); if(!layer)return; const dx=tx-sx, dy=ty-sy; for(let i=0;i<count;i++){setTimeout(()=>{const p=document.createElement('span'); p.className='htParticle '+kind; p.style.left=sx+'px'; p.style.top=sy+'px'; layer.append(p); const k=(i+1)/(count+1), px=sx+dx*k + (Math.random()*18-9), py=sy+dy*k + (Math.random()*18-9); requestAnimationFrame(()=>{p.style.transition='transform .55s ease-out, opacity .55s ease-out'; p.style.transform=`translate(${px-sx}px,${py-sy}px) scale(${.8+Math.random()*.4})`; p.style.opacity='0';}); setTimeout(()=>p.remove(),580);}, delay+i*36);} }
 function spawnTransfer(fromIndex,toIndex,label,kind='swap'){

 }

 function oneVisual(type,payload={}){
